summary: Lets a SIP user agent that receives a dialog-forming request tell the peer its identity, in a request in the reverse direction, with the identity signed by an Authentication Service. This matters because retargeting can change who actually answers. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: When you call and a different person answers, you want to know who really picked up. This lets the answerer tell you their name in a way that can be checked.

questions: what is connected identity in sip
how does sip report who answered a call
